name: Wipe Reveal Text
description: A GSAP text reveal for React: each line is uncovered by a solid bar that sweeps across it, its tail chasing after and the words emerging from behind, line after line on a slow-fast-slow custom ease. Lines are measured after layout, so it works at any width.

props.name: children
props.description: The text. Lines are found after layout, so it reflows at any width.

props.name: barColor
props.description: Colour of the sweeping bar; the text colour by default.

props.name: step
props.description: Seconds for the bar to cross a line (and for its tail to follow).

props.name: reveal
props.description: Seconds after the bar starts before its tail sets off and the words appear.

props.name: trigger
props.description: 'view' plays when it scrolls to start (once); 'mount' plays at once.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, when it isn't the window.

props.name: className
props.description: Font, size, colour. Made for a big bold statement paragraph.
